column1: # The benchmarks CI runs (tools/bench/README.md). Tab-separated: id, module, sets (ab: the weekly and manual A/B
# timing; alloc: the pull-request allocation gate), needs (- or oracles: the oracle tools of tools/testdata must be
# installed), warmup (- or the least number of warm-up iterations of 1 s its cases need), the JMH include regex, and
# the parameters (- or name=v1,v2;name=v1: every combination is a case of its own, timed fork by fork in both
# trees). Every input is synthetic or made with the oracle tools, so that both trees of an A/B and every run of the
# hot-paths: one round of each synthetic steady-state workload of the it module's JitWorkload (a video or audio codec
# stays open across rounds; an image workload codes whole images every round), so its allocation per operation is
# what the code allocates per round of frames, samples or images.
